name: M1128 Stryker Mobile Gun System, present-day fit without the slat cage

published.source: en.wikipedia 'M1128 mobile gun system' and 'Stryker' infobox: hull length 6.95 m (not gated: the model's X extent includes the gun), 2.72 m wide, height over 2.64 m. The gated length is the model's own X extent, 7.26 m: tow pintle (x -3.60) to the muzzle brake (x +3.665, 0.19 m past the nose as drawing A).

references.name: [A] M1128 recognition side drawing, port side
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'M1128 STRYKER MGS.png', 1280 px thumbnail (1280 x 585, transparent background)
references.note: Port side, nose left, flipped. Scaled on the published 6.95 m hull: nose edge px 36 to the rear plate px 1250 = 1214 px, 174.7 px/m; ground (tyre bottoms) at py 584. Second check: the tyres come out 1.11..1.13 m (the 12.00 R20 is about 1.12 m), the hubs at 1.53 / 2.77 / 4.15 / 5.37 m behind the nose, the gun axis at 2.67 m, the muzzle 0.21 m past the nose, the autoloader housing top 2.96..2.98 m. The drawing's roof line reads 2.0..2.05 m, the model's 2.10 (the 2.64 m published height over the ICV's weapon station and photo C put it between). A stylised recognition drawing, not a works drawing: exact false. The rear whips and the brush guards are ignored.

references.name: [C] M1128, front left three-quarters, green, no slat
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'M1128 Stryker MGS.jpg', 1280 px thumbnail
references.note: For the reviewer: the two pale tow shackles hanging from lugs at the top of the raked lower nose plate, their tops level with the tyre tops; the headlamp clusters in tubular brush guards on the glacis corners; the perforated stowage rack on the rear flank; the ceramic tile kit bolt rows; the commander's M2 and the smoke dischargers on the cradle cheeks; plain CARC green (sunlit top about 120,128,99). Numbers and the white data patch are not part of the spec.

must_show: eight big tyres on four axles at x +1.905, +0.665, -0.735, -1.955 (1.57 / 2.81 / 4.21 / 5.43 m behind the nose), the widest gap between the second and third [A, C]
the faceted nose: the raked lower plate from the nose edge (x 3.475, z 1.27) back to the belly (x 2.52, z 0.50), the long glacis rising to the roof at x 1.125 (z 2.10), chamfered front corners [A, C]
the two tow shackles on clevis lugs at the top of the lower nose plate, y +-0.62, x 3.28, hanging to z about 0.88 [C]
headlamp clusters in tubular brush guards on the glacis corners, x 3.15, y +-0.82 [A, C]
the louvred engine deck on the front right of the glacis, x 1.4..2.7, y -0.2..-1.0, and the driver's hatch with three periscopes front left, x 1.5, y +0.55 [A, C]

the bolt-on tile kit in two rows on the upper flanks, the port side access hatch at x -0.13..0.50, and the stowage rack on the upper rear flanks x -3.28..-0.75: a deep box, face 0.25 m off the shoulder (y +-1.52), z 1.58..2.06, nine 0.15 m holes in the upper band and fourteen 0.12 m holes in the lower [A, C]

the low profile turret on the ring at x -1.075: low plinth, the external 105 mm cradle, the long autoloader housing over the rear deck (top z 3.0, rear x -2.95), the commander's M2 front left (top about z 3.2), the gun axis z 2.62, the fume extractor near the cradle and the muzzle brake at x 3.665 [A, C]
the M6 smoke dischargers, four tubes a side on the cradle cheeks at x about 0.0, z 2.7..2.8 [A, C]
rear ramp, door, tail lamps, rear whips (x -3.225); rear lift hooks on the upper rear flank corners (x -3.43..-3.21, y +-1.20, z 2.05..2.24) [C]
plain paint: one coat of CARC green with light road dust on the lower flanks, no camouflage, numbers or markings; team colour in two small strips on the roof edges ahead of the turret (x -0.28..0.53)
